t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2013, a temporary building that has since been taken down, so there is nothing left to see of it here now. It was designed by the Japanese architect Sou Fujimoto, who was born in 1971. The material I have on this one is thin, so I'll say no more than that. It is one of the Serpentine's pavilions, and Fujimoto is the name to remember.
